INPUT        FUNCTIONS                OUTPUT
( Input 1 )  [+ handleInvite]         [( Output 1 )]
             [~ checkQuota]           > Output 2 ]
             [- sendLegacyMail]
             [. UserQuery.Get]
             [~ !CodeGenerator.Next]
             [+ !saveInvite]

Input 1 ==> handleInvite
handleInvite --> checkQuota
handleInvite --> UserQuery.Get
checkQuota --> !CodeGenerator.Next
handleInvite ==> !saveInvite
handleInvite -.-> sendLegacyMail
!saveInvite ==> Output 1
!saveInvite ==> Output 2
